page.layout: One column of index entries, with the letters N. and P. as section headings; no running head or page number; catchword at the lower right.

main_text.l: Mulieres in Ecclesiis Maronitarum à viris sepa-rantur. 481
Codices antiqui verbis & sensu nonnun-quam discrepant à se invicem. 412
Numeri judæorum supra quadringentesimum quomodò exprimantur. 248

page.notes: Lines after "mors." and the three lines of 640, 655 and 638 are Samaritan script, which I cannot read reliably; they are marked illegible, and the letter counts are estimates. "14" after Muhammedis Hegira is doubtful (printed as "r 4"). "27" for Naplus is doubtful (could be 21). Catchword "Px-" is doubtful (could be Pz-). The Chronologia line reads "222. 235." as printed.
